title: Fill the heart until fear finds no place
summary: Let mercy steady the breath before fear writes the day. Keep this close: Let this stay with you: let hope in the Lord outrank the world's reach.
takeaway: Return the breath before fear chooses the story.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: A heart filled with the Lord leaves less room for fear.
source.lifeApplication: When fear starts mapping outcomes, fill the heart before calculating again.
